The '''MM-40 thermal charge''' was a [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]]-based [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal charge]] in use during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It was small enough to fit in a briefcase, yet strong enough to destroy a fortified building.
